literal_meaning: onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound of rapid, rustling movements
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি চটাচট চলে এসো, দেরি হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Hurry up and come quickly; we're getting late.
note: This idiom is widely used in colloquial Bengali to urge speed, reflecting everyday cultural emphasis on efficiency in routine tasks.
